SHELLCHECK_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install ShellCheck. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, and 'from-source' compiles from source.

SHELLCHECK_VERSION.description: Specific version or alias of ShellCheck to install.

SHELLCHECK_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading ShellCheck binary or archive artifacts.

SHELLCHECK_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying available remote ShellCheck releases.

SHELLCHECK_GIT_REPO.description: Upstream Git repository URL for ShellCheck tag resolution and source builds.

SHELLCHECK_FORMAT.description: Default output format passed to ShellCheck when invoked in lint helpers (tty, gcc, checkstyle, diff, json1, quiet).

SHELLCHECK_SHELL.description: Default target shell dialect enforced by ShellCheck (sh, dash, ash, bash, ksh).

SHELLCHECK_OPTIONAL_CHECKS.description: Comma-separated optional ShellCheck checks enabled via -o when supported.
